caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a cream-colored paper and depicts a single large vessel resembling a decorative urn or pitcher with a wide, curved spout and a single handle. The urn stands on a square pedestal base. The rim and the base of the urn are outlined with a beaded or dotted decorative border. There are two decorative, swirling monogram designs present: one is located on the body of the urn, and one appears above the urn, floating independently in open space. The composition is centered on the page, with a thin rectangular border framing the drawing. In the lower left corner within the border, the name “HANS WESTENDORF” is inscribed in small, simple letters. The lines are fine and delicate, and the drawing contains no shading or coloration beyond the pencil lines.
title: Silver Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
